new_result.statement: If original coordinates split as {h}, I, J_V, J_L, K and, after conditioning on K, A[I,J_L]=UV^T has rank r>=1, P_I=[w_I,U] and P_J=[V,w_JL] have full column rank, and every physical row leverage of P_I is <=1/2, define Xi_r=(det(P_I^T P_I))^2 det(V^T V) det(P_J^T P_J). Then |phi_Q(t)|^2 <= 2^((6r+5)/4) pi^(r+3/2) Xi_r^(-1/4)|t|^(-(r+3/2)), hence a continuous C0 density with ||p_Q||inf <= C_r Xi_r^(-1/[2(2r+3)]), C_r=((2r+3)/(2r-1))2^((6r+5)/(2(2r+3))). The other physical cross block A[I,J_V] is arbitrary and survives only as a translated BL argument.
new_result.independent_copy_discipline: The proof retains the hub sum/difference dependence in Fhat_sigma, uses the genuine joint projection density of (V^T W_L,<w_JL,W_L>), and never conditions on a sum/difference coordinate or declares the two independent.
new_result.collision: ||p_Q||_2^2 <= L_r Xi_r^(-1/[2(2r+3)]), L_r=((2r+3)/(2r+1))2^((6r+5)/(2(2r+3))); applying the valid account04/B03 collision lemma gives P(|Q-Q'|<=eps)<=2 L_r Xi_r^(-1/[2(2r+3)]) eps.
